searchText: I have a geth full node, I need to do some analysis in the current state of Ethereum, specifically I want to search for bytes in the code data of all contracts in state (I'll be searching for 4bytes function sigs). What is the best way to do this? you can try to use `debug_accountRange` to retrieve the addresses of the contracts, page by page, and then use `eth_getCode` to get the code of each individual contract (if you see that its code hash is not the code hash of the empty code) <@456226577798135808> wow, thanks, that's exactly what I was looking for! you are welcome

excerpts.content: I have a geth full node, I need to do some analysis in the current state of Ethereum, specifically I want to search for bytes in the code data of all contracts in state (I'll be searching for 4bytes function sigs). What is the best way to do this?

excerpts.author: Deleted User
excerpts.content: you can try to use `debug_accountRange` to retrieve the addresses of the contracts, page by page, and then use `eth_getCode` to get the code of each individual contract (if you see that its code hash is not the code hash of the empty code)
